newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 82 bln marks in tender at 3 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 82 bln marks in tender at 3 pct rate.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that it had allocated 82 billion marks in 14-day securities repurchase funds at a fixed rate of three percent at this week's tender.
A repo pact for 84.0 billion marks also at a fixed three percent rate expires today, Wednesday, so a net two billion marks is draining from the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 290.7 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 28.2 percent of the bids.
The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo fixed at three percent since August.
